strategy.basis: User-provided eight Zero-to-One principles; preserve RQ01-RQ17 and the current RockstarOS 1.0 technical base
strategy.initialAudienceHypothesis: Independent writers and creators with repeated citation-organization and result-tracking work

executionApproval.scope: Native QEMU, existing Hub products, synthetic Wallet/game exchange and SDK; QEMU Developer Preview packaging and one-model physical-device preparation are authorized, while production and real-value gates remain conditional.

commercialPolicy: Preserve native 888 USD cents per contract per month and legacy Web estimates; Rock ATM fee is zero per RQ15; game fees are unspecified; no live billing authorized here.
hardwarePolicy: Native branch prioritizes BlackBerry with model/variant unresolved; Linux QEMU and Android/AOSP are distinct evidence tracks.
firstOperationalTarget: Fresh-host QEMU Developer Preview with reproducible install, launch, shutdown, reopen, backup and removal; synthetic data only

releaseInstallation.cmRule: Present the current implementation as the RockstarOS 1.0 base and advertise only the highest installation and validation stage that has passed its recorded gate

gameExchange.platformFeePolicy: unspecified; zero-fee instruction applies to ATM, not game exchange

gameDeveloperExperience.target: self-made game developers and their players
gameDeveloperExperience.productionPlayerEligibility: unspecified, including players without Rock hardware
gameDeveloperExperience.multiOwnerReadiness: not implemented; GX00 ledger isolation and authenticated account linking required
gameDeveloperExperience.osSubscriptionChange: none; ATM fee clarification does not change existing OS contract

marketExploration.scope: Prediction markets and game asset trading are separate, optional proposals; not an approved OS requirement
